rm(list = ls())
library(tidyverse)

# Sankey Diagram

## Sankey - Version 1

Crops contributing to influx and outflux of water are on the same side of the storage node.

```{r sankey.1, message=FALSE}
# https://r-graph-gallery.com/sankey-diagram.html
library(networkD3)

# A connection data frame is a list of flows with intensity for each flow
links <- data.frame(
  source=paste0("crop", 1:10),
  flux = 10*c(10, 200, 100, 60, 5, 0, -5, -30, -150, -400)
  )
links$target <- rep("Storage", nrow(links))

neutral.thresh <- 100

links <- links %>% 
  mutate(group = if_else(abs(flux) < neutral.thresh, "Neutral", 
                            if_else(flux < neutral.thresh, "Outflux", "Influx")),
         value = if_else(flux == 0, 1, abs(flux)))

# From these flows we need to create a node data frame: it lists every entities involved in the flow
nodes <- data.frame(
  name=c(as.character(links$source), 
  as.character(links$target)) %>% unique(),
  # Add a 'group' column to the nodes data frame: Add one for "Storage"
  group = as.factor(c(as.character(links$group), "Storage"))
)
# Give a color for each group:
my_color <- 'd3.scaleOrdinal() .domain(["Influx", "Neutral", "Outflux", "Storage"]) .range(["steelblue", "#69b3a2", "Orange", "grey"])'

# With networkD3, connection must be provided using id, not using real name like in the links dataframe.. So we need to reformat it.
links$IDsource <- match(links$source, nodes$name)-1 
links$IDtarget <- match(links$target, nodes$name)-1
 
# Make the Network
p <- sankeyNetwork(Links = links, Nodes = nodes,
              Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget",
              Value = "value", NodeID = "name",
              fontSize = 12,
              colourScale = my_color,
              NodeGroup = "group",
              sinksRight = FALSE)
# Creates an interactive graph - flows could be moved around. Check it out!
p
# save the widget
library(htmlwidgets)
widget.path <- paste0(getwd(), "/HtmlWidget")
if(!dir.exists(widget.path)) {dir.create(path = widget.path)}
saveWidget(p, file=paste0( getwd(), "/HtmlWidget/sankey_version1.html"))
```

## Sankey - Version 2

Crops contributing to influx and outflux of water are on the opposite side of the storage node. Graph is interactive - Neutral crops could be pushed aside manually.
```{r sankey.2, message=FALSE, echo = FALSE}
# https://r-graph-gallery.com/sankey-diagram.html
library(networkD3)
 
links <- data.frame(
  source=c(paste0("crop", 1:7), 
           rep("Storage", 3)),
  flux = 10*c(10, 200, 100, 60, 5, 0, -5, 
              -30, -150, -400)
  ) %>% 
  arrange(flux)

links$target <- c(rep("Storage", 7), paste0("crop", 8:10))

neutral.thresh <- 10*10

links <- links %>% 
  mutate(group = if_else(abs(flux) < neutral.thresh, "Neutral", 
                            if_else(flux < neutral.thresh, "Outflux", "Influx")),
         value = if_else(flux == 0, 1, abs(flux)))

# From these flows we need to create a node data frame: it lists every entities involved in the flow
nodes <- data.frame(
  name=c(as.character(links$source), 
  as.character(links$target)) %>% unique(),
  # Add a 'group' column to the nodes data frame: Add one for "Storage"
  group = as.factor(c(links$group[1:7], "Storage", links$group[8:10])) #as.factor(c(as.character(links$group), "Storage"))
)
# Give a color for each group:
my_color <- 'd3.scaleOrdinal() .domain(["Influx", "Neutral", "Outflux", "Storage"]) .range(["steelblue", "#69b3a2", "Orange", "grey"])'

# With networkD3, connection must be provided using id, not using real name like in the links dataframe.. So we need to reformat it.
links$IDsource <- match(links$source, nodes$name)-1 
links$IDtarget <- match(links$target, nodes$name)-1
 
# Make the Network
p <- sankeyNetwork(Links = links, Nodes = nodes,
              Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget",
              Value = "value", NodeID = "name", 
                            fontSize = 12,
              colourScale = my_color,
              NodeGroup = "group",
              sinksRight = TRUE)
# Creates an interactive graph - flows could be moved around. Check it out!
p
# save the widget
saveWidget(p, file=paste0( getwd(), "/HtmlWidget/sankey_version2.html"))
```

# Sankey Version 2 for balance obtained from function get_budget on crop-systems

```{r sankey.2.crop.system, message=FALSE, echo = FALSE}
# https://r-graph-gallery.com/sankey-diagram.html
library(networkD3)
 
# links <- data.frame(
#   source=c(paste0("crop", 1:7), 
#            rep("Storage", 3)),
#   flux = 10*c(10, 200, 100, 60, 5, 0, -5, 
#               -30, -150, -400))
# 
# links$target <- c(rep("Storage", 7), 
#                   paste0("crop", 8:10))

load(file = "data/water_budgets/summ.qs.Rdata")
summ.qs.balance <- summ.qs %>% subset(var == "balance")

links <- data.frame(source = summ.qs.balance$crop.system,
                    flux = summ.qs.balance$`0.5`)
links$target <- c(rep("Storage", nrow(links)))

neutral.thresh <- 10*10

links <- links %>% 
  mutate(group = if_else(abs(flux) < neutral.thresh, "Neutral", 
                            if_else(flux < neutral.thresh, "Outflux", "Influx")),
         value = if_else(flux == 0, 1, abs(flux)))

# From these flows we need to create a node data frame: it lists every entities involved in the flow
nodes <- data.frame(
  name=c(as.character(links$source), 
  as.character(links$target)) %>% unique(),
  # Add a 'group' column to the nodes data frame: Add one for "Storage"
  group = as.factor(c(links$group[1:nrow(links)], "Storage"))
  #as.factor(c(as.character(links$group), "Storage"))
)

# Give a color for each group:
my_color <- 'd3.scaleOrdinal() .domain(["Influx", "Neutral", "Outflux", "Storage"]) .range(["steelblue", "#69b3a2", "Orange", "grey"])'

# With networkD3, connection must be provided using id, not using real name like in the links dataframe.. So we need to reformat it.
links$IDsource <- match(links$source, nodes$name)-1 
links$IDtarget <- match(links$target, nodes$name)-1
 
# Make the Network
p <- sankeyNetwork(Links = links, Nodes = nodes,
              Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget",
              Value = "value", NodeID = "name", 
                            fontSize = 12,
              colourScale = my_color,
              NodeGroup = "group",
              sinksRight = TRUE)
# Creates an interactive graph - flows could be moved around. Check it out!
p
# save the widget
saveWidget(p, file=paste0( getwd(), "/HtmlWidget/sankey_version2_crop.system.html"))
```

# ggsankey

```{r ggsankey}
# Example at: https://r-charts.com/flow/sankey-diagram-ggplot2/
# install.packages("remotes")
# remotes::install_github("davidsjoberg/ggsankey")
library(ggsankey)

crop.data <- data.frame(crop = c(paste0("Crop", 1:10)),
                        flux = c(10, 200, 100, 60, 5, 0, -5, -30, -150, -400))
neutral.thresh <- 10

crop.data <- crop.data %>% 
  mutate(flux = as.numeric(flux),
         flux_type = if_else(abs(flux) < neutral.thresh, "Neutral", 
                             if_else(flux < neutral.thresh, "Outflux", "Influx")),
         flux.abs = if_else(flux == 0, 1, abs(flux)))

df <- crop.data %>%
  make_long(crop, flux_type, value = flux.abs) 

ggplot(df, aes(x = x, 
               next_x = next_x, 
               node = node, 
               next_node = next_node,
               fill = factor(next_node)),
               label = node,
       value = value) +
  geom_sankey() +
  theme_sankey(base_size = 16) +
  scale_fill_discrete(na.translate = FALSE) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Flux Type"))

# The widths should change by the flux value, but it's not working.
```

# Treemap

```{r treemap, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Inspiration from: https://www.data-to-viz.com/graph/treemap.html
# libraries
library(tidyverse)
# install.packages("treemap")
library(treemap)

load(file = "data/water_budgets/summ.qs.Rdata")
summ.qs.balance <- summ.qs %>% subset(var == "balance")
crop.data <- data.frame(crop = summ.qs.balance$crop.system,
                    flux = summ.qs.balance$`0.5`)

# crop.data <- data.frame(crop = c(paste0("Crop", 1:10)),
#                         flux = c(10, 200, 100, 60, 5, 0, -5, -30, -150, -400))
neutral.thresh <- 10

crop.data <- crop.data %>% 
  mutate(flux = as.numeric(flux),
         flux_type = if_else(abs(flux) < neutral.thresh, "Neutral", 
                             if_else(flux < neutral.thresh, "Outflux", "Influx")),
         flux.abs = abs(flux))

# Plot
p <- treemap(crop.data,
            # data
            index=c("flux_type", "crop"),
            vSize="flux.abs",
            type="index",

            # Main
            title="",
            palette="Dark2",

            # Borders:
            border.col=c("black", "grey"),
            border.lwds=c(1,0.5,0.1),

            # Labels
            fontsize.labels=c(32, 20),
            # fontsize.labels=c(0.7, 0.4, 0.3),
            fontcolor.labels=c("white", "white"),
            fontface.labels=1,
            bg.labels=c("transparent"),
            align.labels=list( c("center", "center"), c("left", "top")),
            overlap.labels=0.5#, inflate.labels=T

)

# Interactive treemap
# install.packages("d3treeR") # Couldn't find. Need to look up 
# library(d3treeR)

```
